Identified as this saint because: Reached through the Russian Wikipedia: «Феодор I (епископ Ростовский)» carries Q4482715, whose P18 this is. **The name is shared and the folder's own types straddle both claimants, so the day is what settles it.** There are two Theodores of Rostov — the first bishop, c.1023, kept 8 June, and the venerable Theodore who founded Borisoglebsky with Paul, kept 22 October. This folder's attestations are 8 June in both the Russian and Greek calendars, its Russian line reads «Свт. Феодора, еп. Суздальского (ок. 1023)» and its Greek «Όσιος Θεόδωρος Επίσκοπος Ροστώφ και Σούζνταλ», so it is the bishop; the `venerable` type is the Greek Όσιος and not a second man. The file names the bishop of Suzdal, and the 300x300 icon of «Фёдор и Павел Ростовские» — the other Theodore, with Paul — is explicitly NOT taken. 1282x2667. Commons describes it: St. Fedor, Bishop of Suzdal
